items.title: S85-DRESSED-V.P. (matter-dressed spectral action)
items.what: Test whether a matter-dressed spectral action V.P. (substrate + GGE entropy contribution) DOES select τ_fold as a critical point, even though the bare V.P. does not.
items.inputs: §W8-90 carry-forward; matter-dressed action expansion; substrate-action coupling to GGE quasiparticles.

items.title: S85-MELLIN-CONE-UNIVERSALITY-EXTENDED-TRIPLES** (extend §W8-89)
items.what: extend MG-0 inheritance test from 3 framework-independent spectral triples to 7-10. Candidates: NC sphere, Connes' spectral triple on (C^∞(M), L²(M, S), D_M) for compact M; Heisenberg manifold spectral triple. Confirm empty-gap cone bound [1.5, 2.5] holds across the extended set.
items.inputs: §W8-89 script, spectral triple library (Connes, van Suijlekom).
